title: Slovenia's Economy Surges but Public Broadcaster Crisis Exposes Institutional… · 27 Aug
keywords: Slovenia, RTV Slovenia, public broadcasting, media independence, GDP growth, inflation, Bank of Slovenia, IMAD, Slovenian economy, eurozone, fiscal policy, Q2 2026, institutional crisis, public media funding
notes: Slovenia recorded unexpectedly strong economic growth of 5 percent in the second quarter of 2026, yet the country faces a parallel crisis over the funding and independence of its national public broadcaster, RTV Slovenia. The two developments together reveal a nation caught between headline success and underlying institutional strain. For citizens, the question is whether prosperity on paper translates into stability in both living costs and democratic governance.
